data.name: The Regular: Same Dog Every Time
data.detailed_description:
A cozy hot dog cart game about simple work, satisfying routines, and strange regulars.

The Regular is a relaxing first-person hot dog making game where you run your own little street cart, prepare orders by hand, manage your supplies, decorate your stand, and settle into the calm rhythm of serving customers one hot dog at a time.

Open the cart, stock your buns and hot dogs, listen carefully, and build each order by hand. Keep it plain, add toppings, finish it with the right sauces, grab drinks when needed, and send each order across the counter with that small, perfect feeling of a job done right.

Make Hot Dogs By Hand

Every order is a tiny ritual. Grab a bun, place the hot dog, add toppings, add sauces in the right order, and serve it up.

The joy is in the little movements: opening containers, checking stock, choosing ingredients, and turning a simple snack into exactly what someone asked for.

Serve A Line Of Hungry Customers

Customers arrive with their own orders, patience, and expectations. Some want something simple. Others want multiple hot dogs, specific toppings, sauces, drinks, or known recipes.

Read the order, build it correctly, and keep the cart moving. Mistakes can happen, stock can run low, and not every customer is easy, but the heart of the game is relaxed, tactile service: listen, prepare, serve, repeat.

Restock, Earn Money, And Improve The Cart

A good shift starts before the first customer arrives. Buy supplies, keep an eye on stock, and make sure the cart is ready before opening for business.

As you earn money, you can unlock new toppings, buy upgrades, expand what you can serve, and make each shift a little smoother than the last.

Decorate Your Stand

Your cart is yours. Add decorations, customize the little details, and make the stand feel more personal over time.

It is still a hot dog cart, but it can become your hot dog cart.

Daily Events

Some shifts come with a special twist. A good mood on the street, a supplier mix-up, a rush of customers, better tips, more patient orders, or a perfect shift challenge can change the rhythm for one day.

Adapt, take the bonus where you can, and see what kind of shift today becomes.

Close The Shift, Breathe, And Start Again

When the essentials run out, the shift winds down. Count what you earned, check your progress, restock, improve the cart, and get ready for the next day.

There is no rush to become perfect. Learn the cart. Learn the orders. Learn the rhythm.

Something Is Different About This Cart

Most of the time, The Regular is exactly what it seems to be: a warm, relaxing hot dog game about serving food and making a living.

But there is also something unusual hiding inside the routine.

Keep your cool. Keep the customers happy. Keep your cover.

Features

  • Run a first-person hot dog cart
    Prepare food directly from the cart with simple, satisfying interactions.

  • Build customer orders by hand
    Use buns, hot dogs, toppings, sauces, and drinks to match what each customer wants.

  • Manage stock and money
    Buy supplies, avoid running out too early, and make each shift count.

  • Unlock toppings, recipes, upgrades, and decorations
    Grow the cart over time with new ingredients, useful improvements, and personal touches.

  • React to daily events
    Special one-shift modifiers can change tips, patience, stock, rewards, and customer flow.

  • Enjoy a relaxed shift-based loop
    Open the cart, serve customers, close the shift, improve, and return.

  • Meet a strange cast of regulars
    Serve one oddly familiar customer in a growing collection of disguises, and try not to say the obvious part out loud.

  • Cozy, tactile, and lightly mysterious
    A calm food-making game with a quiet oddness beneath the surface.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
